notes.title: Reviews are starting to roll in!
notes.content:
Reviews for Legacy of the Elder Star:

GamerPros gives it 8.5 out of 10: "Legacy of the Elder Star knocks it out of the park, retaining the retro charm of the genre without shackling itself to the past."
Enemy Slime gives it 4/5: "The game runs like heaven, and controls wonderfully."

And from pre-launch coverage:

IND13 says: "The real treat, in my opinion, is the game’s art, hand-painted by artist Erik Exeter. The game is beautiful to look at, and screenshots look like they’re polished mock-ups or concept art."
Game Octane says: "One of the things I respect most about this team is the addition of modes that are accessible to people with disabilities."

We've also been collecting Let's Plays on our YouTube channel. Here are a couple we particularly like:

Yippee Ki Yay Mr Falcon
RobJNova
